On August 21, 2025, a Visual Inspection was performed on Unit 14. During this inspection, Unit 14 was found to be in overall fair condition. The following are the results of the inspection: A.) Tiles: Some yellow deposits were found on the surface of the tiles, as well as some minor coating loss. B.) Secondary Air Nozzles: Medium erosion was found at the tips and the walls of the secondary air nozzles. One crack was found in the end of one and was blended out during this inspection. C.) CIL: CIL was found with some erosion near secondary air nozzles and some erosion on the CIL near the secondary air nozzles. D.) CIL Overlapping Ring: The overlapping ring was found in overall acceptable condition. E.) HGC Collar: HGC collar was found with some minor erosion. F.) Pulsation Probe Holder: The pulsation probe holder was found to be in acceptable condition. G.) HGC: HGC was found with some coating loss. It is in overall acceptable condition. H.) HGC Split Line Flange: HGC flange was found in acceptable condition. I.) Inlet C-Segments: The c-segments were found with medium erosion. J.) Row One Blades and Vanes: Row 1 blades and vanes were found with erosion on both leading and trailing edges. K.) Row Two Blades and Vanes: Row 2 blades and vanes had minor erosion. L.) Entry Segments: Entry segments were found with medium erosion. M.) Burner: Burner was found with yellow deposits. Nozzle and swirler was in acceptable condition. A leak was found at one of the pipes on the cover that was repaired by the customer.
